message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|------------------------|
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1230 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60647 | Many curries and stir‑fries can be made vegetarian; they also offer a dedicated vegetarian menu. |
| **Thai Basil** | 1230 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60647 | Offers a range of vegetarian curries, salads, and noodle dishes; you can request no meat or seafood. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1230 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60647 | Provides vegetarian options such as tofu pad thai, vegetable curry, and a vegetarian “special” menu. |

All three restaurants are located in the same building on W. 31st Street, so you can easily walk between them if you’d like to try a few different dishes. They’re all well‑reviewed for their authentic flavors and accommodating staff who can help you customize meals to suit a vegetarian diet. Enjoy your meal!
